en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a tram in the foreground and 3–4‑storey townhouses lining both sides of a broad cobbled street. In the background stands a large church or town‑hall tower with a layered, domed spire topped by a cross. The facades bear painted advertisements in German script. People are walking along the sidewalks and in the open square, which has a central lamppost.
